text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Ah, he really did come... Ah! I mean, you were talking about this place the other day, remember? The food stall with the unusually "normal" crepes... So I kinda figured you might show up today~ Ah, no! Wait, that came out wrong! It's not like I was stalking you or anything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ほんとに来た……
や、
ほら、
こないだ君、
ここの話してたじゃん？
屋台のクレープすごい普通って。
だから
今日あたり来るかな
って──
あっ、
ちが、
違うよ？　
全然その、
ストーカー的なアレじゃなくて！

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, yes... Thank you... I see. Today is the 28th, "Doctor Yuni's" birthday.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
あっ、
はい……
ど
うも……
そっか、
今日28日か、
ユニ博士の誕生日だ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Mm. Well, makes sense. When it comes to Astrum avatars, it's generally the players who set their own character name, and even their birthday.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
まあ、
そうだよね。
アストルムのアバターって、
なんかキャラ名もそうだけど、
誕生日とかも
本人ママ設定しがちな風潮あるもんね。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, don't get me wrong, it's not like I'm a... um, a klutz or anything like that, okay? I wasn't trying to drop a cheesy line such as "Ooops, how clumsy can I be★" or anything of the sort.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、いや、
違うよ？
全然、
その、
ドジっ子アピとかじゃないよ？
あのひと意外と
天然なトコあるなー、
的なの狙ったわけじゃなくて──

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry, you took the time to celebrate me, so I'll just say it. It's fine to celebrate my birthday today, but it's actually not "today"... Oh, are you fine just standing around to talk? Shall we find somewhere to sit? Like somewhere around there...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ごめん、
祝ってくれたから
一応言っとこうかな。
私の誕生日、
今日でもいいんだけど
今日ではない
っていうか……
あ、
立ち話で大丈夫？　
座る？　
座ろっか、
どっかその辺。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Strictly speaking, about me -- Ah, I mean the "Shingyouji-san" in this world, okay? My date of birth on my family register is the 29th, not the 28th. That's right, February 29th... To put it in the layfolk terms, a so called "Leap Day".
text_block_list.orig_text:
厳密には私──
あ、
今のこっちの、
真行寺さんの私ね？
私、
戸籍上の出生日は
28日じゃなくて
29日なんだよね。
そう、
２月29日……
端的に換言すると
「閏日」
ってやつ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: By the way, apparently when I was still in preschool, I would often cause riots back home, saying things like "It's not fair I only get presents once every four years!" Of course, I remember nothing of the sort, so it's probably just some made up story from my gramps back home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちなみに
「４年に一回しかプレゼントもらえないじゃん！」
って言って
しばしば
家庭内暴動起こしてたらしいよ、
未就学時代の私。
もちろん
記憶にないっていうか、
ほぼ
後世の作り話だと思ってるけど。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: It's not like I only get celebrated once every four years, obviously. Usually it's either the day before or the day after... I think it's more often the day after? So on normal years, I just celebrate around then and age like a regular person.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなワケないしね、
４年に一回とか。
おおむね
前日か翌日──
翌日パターンのが多いかな、
平年は
その辺りが誕生日扱いになって
全然普通に歳とってくし。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Huh? What were we talking about just now... ah, right, my birthday. That's right. It's not "today", but it's fine to celebrate it today too. Thank you for celebrating with me~ Ehehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
今コレ何の話だっけ……
あ、
だから
私の誕生日ね？
そう、
今日じゃないけど、
今日でもだいじょぶですって話。
祝ってくれて
ありがとうございます──
なんて、
えへへ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Really? Amazing, two birthdays in a row... That's a bargain, I'm so happy. Ah, then, I'll be waiting here again tomorrow... AH! No! It's not like I was waiting here today! Hahaha... that was close-
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんと？　
すごい、
誕生日２日目ってやつだ。
お得すぎ、
嬉しい。
あっ、
じゃあ、
そしたら私、
明日もここで待ってるから──
あ、
ちが、
今日は待ってたわけじゃないけど！　
あはは……
あぶねー
